role: Confirmatory third-dataset evaluation of the locked ranked-MNN promotion policy against preregistered baselines
dataset: UCI Human Activity Recognition Using Smartphones (UCI-HAR)
dataset_status: Never downloaded, inspected, or used in any prior FedVocabHAR phase (Phases 0-4).
sensor: Waist-mounted smartphone total_acc XYZ plus magnitude, from the raw Inertial Signals folder (not the 561 engineered features)

window.note: Native UCI-HAR windows are 128 samples with 50% overlap; they are used as shipped. Train and Test folders are pooled and re-split by subject.

fold_rule: test(f) = {f, f+5, f+10, f+15, f+20, f+25}; remaining 24 subjects ascending, rotated left by 6*(f-1); train = first 12, selection = next 6, integration = last 6.

frozen_encoder_recipe.trained_on: train_subjects only, known activities only for supervised episodes; no selection, integration, or test subject window is used in training
frozen_encoder_recipe.selection_rule: None. No model, checkpoint, epoch, or hyperparameter selection may use UCI-HAR labels beyond the training subjects.

frozen_promotion_policy.calibration: Phase 3D quantile calibration computed from train and selection subjects only: novelty_false_alarm_quantile 0.02, local_distance_quantile 0.90, agreement_similarity_quantile 0.10
frozen_promotion_policy.query_accounting: Every oracle call is counted against the budget, including calls whose answer is a known activity. Candidates are not filtered by ground truth before querying.
frozen_promotion_policy.integration_clients: integration_subjects act as federated clients; their labels are hidden from discovery, matching, and promotion and are revealed only to the simulated oracle for at most 4 medoids per fold and to compute metrics.

preregistered_baselines.source: notebooks/FedVocabHAR_Phase5A_Baselines.ipynb; all baselines share the encoder, calibration, clients, and 4-query budget
preregistered_baselines.random_query: Uniformly sample up to 4 retained local clusters across clients and query their medoids (20 seeds, mean reported).
preregistered_baselines.support_only: Rank all retained local clusters by support without cross-client agreement; query the top 4.
preregistered_baselines.novelty_top_b: Query the 4 single windows with the highest novelty score across clients; each queried window becomes a one-window prototype.
preregistered_baselines.centralized_oracle: Pool all integration windows, cluster centrally with the same distance threshold, rank by support, query the top 4 (upper bound; not federated).
preregistered_baselines.component_mixture: Fed-GCD-style: per-client Gaussian mixture components matched at the server by Hungarian assignment on cosine similarity; rank matched pairs by support; query top 4.

primary_hypothesis: H1: On UCI-HAR test subjects, ranked_mnn achieves higher mean novel macro-F1 than random_query, and does so in at least 4 of 5 folds.
secondary_hypotheses: H2: ranked_mnn achieves higher mean entry purity than support_only.
H3: ranked_mnn uses no more label queries than support_only.
H4: The gap between centralized_oracle and ranked_mnn novel macro-F1 is less than 0.15 (cost of federation).

gates.G1_cache_integrity: All 30 subjects x 6 activities present; at least 40 windows per subject-activity cell; channel count 4; window length 128.
gates.G2_known_geometry: Mean prototype known macro-F1 on test subjects >= 0.75.
gates.G3_primary: H1 holds (ranked_mnn novel macro-F1 > random_query mean AND in >= 4/5 folds).
gates.G6_budget: Label queries <= 4 in every fold (hard constraint; violation invalidates the run).

statistics: Means over 5 outer folds with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals (10000 resamples over folds); paired per-fold differences reported for every baseline against ranked_mnn. With 5 folds, exact paired sign tests are reported but the preregistered decision rule is the fold-count criterion in G3.
execution_order: 1. Commit this manifest to https://github.com/mhshayesteh/FedVocabHAR before downloading UCI-HAR.
2. Phase 5C-A: download, build cache, run G1 only. No labels beyond the G1 count table are inspected.
3. Phase 5C-B: train one encoder per fold on train_subjects; save checkpoints; no metrics on non-train subjects are printed.
4. Phase 5C-C: run ranked_mnn and all baselines on integration clients; evaluate on test subjects; open test labels exactly once; write per-fold JSON, CSV, and decision JSON.
5. Any deviation must be recorded in phase5c_deviations.md before results are reported.
rule: This is the only remaining confirmatory dataset. If any gate fails, the result is reported as a failed confirmatory test; UCI-HAR may not be reused for redesign, tuning, or selection.
